privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Learnova collects, uses, and protects personal and institutional data across the platform.
privacy.s1p1: Learnova (“we”, “us”) is an enterprise AI learning platform for institutions. This Privacy Policy explains what information we process when you use Learnova websites, dashboards, and related services.
privacy.s2Intro: Depending on how you use Learnova, we may process:
privacy.s2i1: Account details such as name, email address, role, and institution affiliation
privacy.s2i2: Academic structure data (campuses, programs, batches) entered by administrators
privacy.s2i3: Usage and device information needed for sessions, security, and product reliability
privacy.s2i4: Support messages you send to us
privacy.s3i1: Provide authentication, dashboards, and institution management features
privacy.s3i2: Send transactional email such as verification and password reset links
privacy.s3i3: Improve reliability, accessibility, and user experience
privacy.s3i4: Protect against abuse and unauthorized access
privacy.s4p1: We do not sell personal data. We may share information with service providers that help us operate Learnova (for example hosting or email delivery), only as needed to provide the service, or when required by law.
privacy.s5p1: We retain account and institutional records for as long as needed to operate the service or as required by institutional policy. Security practices are described on our <security>Security</security> page.
privacy.s6p1: You may request access, correction, or deletion of personal account data by contacting us. Institution administrators control academic records within their tenant.
privacy.s7p1: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by updating the “Last updated” date on this page.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: The rules for using Learnova websites, accounts, and institutional workspaces.
terms.s1p1: By accessing or using Learnova, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you use Learnova on behalf of an institution, you represent that you have authority to bind that institution.
terms.s2p1: Learnova provides learning and academic operations software, including institution structure, authentication, and related modules. Features may evolve as the product develops. Some capabilities may be preview, limited, or unavailable depending on your plan and deployment.
terms.s3i1: You are responsible for safeguarding credentials and session devices
terms.s3i3: Notify us promptly of unauthorized account use
terms.s3i4: Institution admins are responsible for user provisioning within their tenant
terms.s4i1: Attempt to bypass authentication, authorization, or audit controls
terms.s4i2: Probe, disrupt, or overload the service except through approved testing
terms.s4i3: Upload unlawful, harmful, or infringing content
terms.s5p1: Academic and organizational data entered into Learnova remains under the control of the institution that owns the tenant, subject to these Terms and our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
terms.s6p1: Learnova branding, software, and documentation are protected by applicable IP laws. You receive a limited right to use the service; you do not acquire ownership of the platform.
terms.s7p1: Learnova is provided on an “as available” basis for evaluation and academic use. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we disclaim warranties of uninterrupted availability or fitness for a particular purpose.

security.title: Security
security.description: How Learnova approaches authentication, access control, and protecting institutional data.
security.s1p1: Security is foundational to Learnova. We design for institutional trust: clear roles, session hygiene, and auditable actions across the academic workspace.
security.s2i1: Password-based sign-in with hashed credential storage
security.s2i2: JWT access tokens with rotating refresh cookies
security.s2i3: Session listing and revocation for signed-in devices
security.s2i4: Email verification and password reset flows
security.s3p1: Role-based access control (RBAC) gates sensitive institution and academic operations. Permissions such as institution read/manage are enforced in the API layer, not only in the UI.
security.s4i1: Transport encryption via HTTPS in production deployments
security.s4i3: Soft-delete patterns for recoverable institutional records
security.s4i4: Audit logging for key authentication and management events
security.s5p1: If you believe you have found a security issue, please email <email>shuklamanya99@gmail.com</email> with steps to reproduce. Do not publicly disclose vulnerabilities until we have had a reasonable chance to investigate and remediate.
security.s6p1: See also our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> and <terms>Terms of Service</terms>.
